items.summaryEn: Reigning world champion Lando Norris says McLaren's relative lack of pace surprised him and he sees little chance of a hat-trick of F1 wins at this weekend's Italian Grand Prix.
detailZh: 迈凯伦“无法争夺意大利大奖赛杆位”，兰多·诺里斯沮丧地承认
在F1意大利大奖赛的周五练习赛后，兰多·诺里斯听起来一脸困惑，因为迈凯伦“在我们本以为擅长的弯角表现很糟糕”
在蒙扎的“速度圣殿”完成两节练习课后，现任世界冠军兰多·诺里斯几乎找不到理由相信自己能在这个周末的意大利大奖赛上实现F1三连胜。
诺里斯在蒙扎第二节练习赛中位列第四，落后梅赛德斯的拉塞尔 0.384秒，他对迈凯伦相比厂商车队在速度上的相对不足表示惊讶。
诺里斯（Norris）说：“状态不太体面，只是在节奏上挣扎得更多。说实话，在我们原本以为会擅长的弯角，我们表现很差；而在我们原本以为会很差的弯角，我们反而没那么差，但仍然落后。所以，目前我们的处境并不乐观。我们会看看今晚能做些什么。”
GPS轨迹数据显示，诺里斯和他的队友皮亚斯特里（皮亚斯特里）——后者排名第六——与拉塞尔（Russell）相比主要在直道上损失时间，这可能是MCL40空气动力学效率相对不足与电池输出策略不同共同导致的结果。
诺里斯似乎还在暗示，他在高速的瓦里安特·阿斯卡里（Variante Ascari）减速弯损失了近0.1秒，而这个弯角本应是迈凯伦的强项。相反，诺里斯在低速的一号和二号减速弯中能够跟上拉塞尔的节奏，而这通常不是他这台2026年赛车的强项。
迈凯伦还必须警惕法拉利，后者凭借勒克莱尔（勒克莱尔）在第二次自由练习中拿下第二名，因为法拉利带来了升级后的动力单元以及针对这条赛道的空气动力学更新。
“肯定会比以前更艰难，”诺里斯承认道，他刚刚在匈牙利和荷兰连续夺冠，正力求延续自己的连胜势头。“排名靠前的车手之间差距很小。后面的车手也落后不远，所以他们很容易给我们带来意外。”
“我完全不觉得我们有争夺杆位的实力。但我们只需要专注于拿到一个不错的成绩。”
迈凯伦对H-Wing给予认可
迈凯伦是最新一支引入旋转尾翼的车队，这一概念由法拉利首创，技术总监尼尔·霍尔德伊确认其所谓的'H-Wing'设计效果符合预期。
霍尔迪（Houldey）说：“我们对赛车在高速和低速路段之间的平衡感到相当满意，尽管距离我们的目标还差大约十分之三秒。”“新的H-Wing前翼表现出色，正如我们在工厂进行测试后所预期的那样，我们现在期待它在本周末接下来的比赛中带来性能提升。”
“我们今晚的重点将是微调能量管理，因为通过更好的能量回收和释放，仍有找到圈速提升的机会。关键在于找到那最后的零点几秒，以缩小与前方车队的差距。”

detailEn: McLaren "not in the fight for Italian GP pole", admits downbeat Lando Norris
Lando Norris sounded baffled after Friday practice at Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix as McLaren was "bad in the corners we expected to be good at"

After completing two practice sessions on Monza's Temple of Speed, reigning world champion Lando Norris has found few reasons to believe he can deliver a hat-trick of Formula 1 wins at this weekend's Italian Grand Prix.
Norris claimed fourth in Monza's second practice outing, 0.384s behind Mercedes' George Russell, as he sounded surprised by McLaren's relative lack of pace compared to the works team.

"Not very decent, just struggling a lot more with pace," Norris said. "To be honest, in the corners we expected to be good at, we're bad. And the corners we expected to be bad at, we're not so bad at, but we're still off. So, we're not in a great place at the minute. We'll see what we can do overnight."

GPS traces show Norris and team-mate Oscar Piastri, who took sixth, are mainly losing time on the straights compared to Russell, which could be a combination of the MCL40's relative lack of aerodynamic efficiency and a different battery deployment profile.

What Norris also appears to be hinting at is that he is losing almost a tenth of a second in the fast Variante Ascari chicane, which would naturally be a strong corner for the McLaren. Conversely, Norris was able to keep pace with Russell through the slow-speed first and second chicanes, which is not generally a strength of his 2026 car.
McLaren will also have to be wary of Ferrari, which took second in FP2 courtesy of Charles Leclerc as it fields an improved power unit and track-specific aerodynamic updates.

"It's going to be tougher than before, for sure," Norris acknowledged, as he aims to continue his streak of wins following back-to-back victories in Hungary and the Netherlands. "It's close between a lot of the guys at the top. The guys behind are not that far behind either, so they can easily surprise us.
"I definitely don't feel we're in the fight for pole at all. But we just need to focus on getting a decent result."
McLaren gives H-Wing the nod of approval
McLaren was the latest team to introduce a rotating rear wing, a concept introduced by Ferrari, with technical director Neil Houldey confirmed its so-called 'H-Wing' design worked as expected.

"We're reasonably pleased with the car's balance between high-and low-speed sections, though we are around three-tenths off where we want to be," Houldey said. "The new H-Wing performed well, as we expected following the testing put in at the factory, and we now anticipate it to add performance as we head into the rest of the weekend.

"Our focus this evening will be on fine-tuning the energy management, as there is still an opportunity to find lap time through better harvesting and deployment. It’s about finding those last few fractions of a second to close the gap with the teams ahead."

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在意大利大奖赛练习赛后担心梅赛德斯的极速问题
刘易斯·汉密尔顿认为，在F1意大利大奖赛周五练习之后，法拉利需要做些工作来应对梅赛德斯的极速优势
刘易斯·汉密尔顿认为梅赛德斯在蒙扎拥有超越法拉利的极速优势，而这在F1意大利大奖赛上将至关重要
法拉利根据ADUO规则获准在蒙扎带来了引擎升级，并在其主场站开局表现亮眼，夏尔·勒克莱尔在第一次练习赛中领跑，助车队占据前两名。
但在第二节练习赛中，乔治·拉塞爾（拉塞尔）奋起反击，为梅赛德斯拿下全场最快，勒克莱尔（Leclerc）位居第二，而汉密尔顿仅列第五，落后0.457秒。虽然调校上的改动在二练中似乎适得其反，汉密尔顿还对梅赛德斯展现出的明显极速优势感到担忧。
“直线速度非常值得担忧，”汉密尔顿说。“看看刚才的差距，仅在直道上我就比乔治慢了大约0.6秒。这是我们需要研究的问题。
“然后就是平衡性，真的很难从车里做出一个像样的单圈。出于某种原因，FP2的车并不好开。所以我们做了一些改动，但本来不应该这么糟。所以我们可能会回退设置，但我们会看一看能否让赛车变得更好。”
汉密尔顿并不确定极速落后梅赛德斯的原因，但他对升级版引擎表示了认可——据了解该引擎能多提供15马力，预计可将与梅赛德斯的差距缩小一半。
“如果是部署问题的话，那是我们需要研究的，”汉密尔顿谈到这一差距时说。“但发动机是一项进步，我非常感谢工厂里为此努力的伙计们。不过我们的部署计划与我们的竞争对手们不同。
法拉利车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔也对发动机升级表示支持，并认为与梅赛德斯的差距是多重因素造成的，而不仅仅是发动机功率。
“看起来他们在直道上的阻力可能更小，所以这绝对是我们需要研究的问题，”瓦塞尔说。
“你必须记住直线性能的问题。这关乎阻力，关乎赛车重量，关乎一切。不仅仅是发动机。我们确实迈进了一步，我们带来ADUO2可不是白来的。但我认为我们仍然有相当大的差距。”

detailEn: Lewis Hamilton worried about Mercedes top speed after Italian GP practice
Lewis Hamilton feels Ferrari has work to do to counter the Mercedes top speed at Monza following Friday practice at the F1 Italian GP
Lewis Hamilton feels Mercedes has a top speed advantage over Ferrari at Monza which will be crucial at the Formula 1 Italian Grand Prix.
Ferrari delivered an engine upgrade at Monza as permitted under ADUO, and started its home round brightly with Charles Leclerc leading a 1-2 in first practice.

But in second practice George Russell fought back to top the session for Mercedes ahead of Leclerc in second with Hamilton down in fifth with a 0.457s deficit. While set-up changes appeared to backfire during second practice, Hamilton was also concerned by the superior top speed Mercedes demonstrated.

“Straightline speed, it's considerable to worry about,” Hamilton said. “Just looking at the deltas just there, I was losing something like six tenths to George, just in the straights. Which is something we need to look into.

“Then just balance, it was really, really hard to pull the lap out of the car. It was not an easy one to drive in FP2 for some reason. So we made a couple of changes but it shouldn't have really been bad. So we might revert, but we're going to look and see if we can make the car better.”

Hamilton was unsure what was causing the top speed deficit to Mercedes but did given approval to the upgraded engine which is understood to provide 15bhp more and is estimated to halve the deficit to Mercedes.

“What we need to look into, if it's deployment,” Hamilton said about the deficit. “But the engine is an improvement which I'm really grateful for the guys back at the factory for working on. But our deployment schedule is different to the others, our competitors.
Ferrari team boss Fred Vasseur also gave backing to the engine upgrade and felt the deficit to Mercedes was down to multiple factors rather than solely engine power.
“It seems like they maybe have less drag for the straights, so that's something we need to definitely look at,” Vasseur said.

“You have to keep in mind the performance in the straight line. It's the drag, it's the weight of the car, it's everything. It's not just the engine. We did a step for sure and we didn't bring ADUO2 for nothing. But I think we still have a decent gap.”

当被问及在法拉利主场大奖赛上从第一排或杆位发车的可能性时，汉密尔顿回答说：“那是梦想，终极梦想。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿驾驶着一辆罕见的法拉利 F40 抵达意大利大奖赛，并透露这辆车的发动机编号与他的赛车号码相同。
“我们能不能做到是个非常大的问题。今晚我们需要做大量工作，试图弄清楚我们是否在什么地方出了错，以及是否有可以改进的地方——而可以改进的地方有很多。”
“另外，我认为在赛道上出现在正确的时间、正确的位置也会有很大的帮助。”
安东内利预测杆位之争将会非常激烈
尽管他本人并不是杆位争夺的焦点，但安东内利认同汉密尔顿的判断，即这将是一场势均力敌的较量。
这位20岁的意大利车手在积分榜榜首以59分的优势领先拉塞尔和汉密尔顿，而诺里斯以83分之差位居第四。
梅赛德斯车队选择安东内利的主场赛事作为他因超出引擎使用配额而不可避免受罚的最合适场地，因为他们认为，在周日的比赛中从队尾往前追赶，在蒙扎要比今年赛历上剩余的大多数赛道更容易。
梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利在法拉利于意大利大奖赛练习赛上首次启用一台新引擎后，谈了自己对法拉利的看法。
安东内利说：“今天和平时有点不太一样。更多地专注于长距离测试，所以说实话感觉有点奇怪，但总的来说，今天很不错。”
“我们收集了大量数据，现在期待着接下来几天的表现。
法拉利凭借新引擎确实前进了一步，现在两队的速度不相上下。我们知道他们的赛车在弯道中有多出色，所以明天杆位的争夺肯定会非常激烈。”
“挣扎”中的诺里斯并不指望能争夺杆位
诺里斯满怀信心地来到意大利，此前他在匈牙利和荷兰背靠背夺冠，重新点燃了他卫冕车手总冠军的希望。
然而，这位英国车手情绪低落，因为迈凯伦似乎无法在这条与前两站赛历赛道特性截然不同的赛道上复刻他们近期的状态。
诺里斯说：“不算太好。我在速度上挣扎得厉害多了。”
兰多·诺里斯情绪低落，反思了迈凯伦在周五练习赛中令人沮丧的速度不足。
"在我们本以为会表现好的弯角，我们反而表现很差，而在本以为会表现差的弯角，我们却没有那么差。"
"但我们仍然落后。所以目前处境并不太好。我们会看看今晚能做些什么，但肯定会比之前更艰难。"
"前排很多车手之间的差距非常小。身后的车手也离得不算远，所以他们很容易给我们带来意外。"
"我完全觉得我们没有在争夺杆位的行列中，但我们需要专注于拿到一个体面的成绩。"

"Ferrari definitely took a step forward with a new engine and now the speeds are the same. We know how good their car is into the corners so, for sure, it's going to be a tight fight for pole tomorrow."
'Struggling' Norris doesn't expect to fight for pole
Norris arrived in Italy full of confidence having claimed back-to-back victories in Hungary and the Netherlands to reignite his hopes of defending his drivers' title.
However, the Brit was downcast after McLaren appeared unable to replicate their recent form at a track with very different characteristics to the previous two on the schedule.
Norris said: "Not very decent. Just struggling a lot more with pace.
A downbeat Lando Norris reflects on McLaren’s frustrating lack of pace in Friday Practice.
"In the corners we expected to be good at we're bad at and in the corners we expected to be bad at, we're not so bad at.
"But we're still off. So not in a great place at the minute. We'll see what we can do overnight but it's going to be tougher than before for sure.
"It's close between a lot of the guys at the top. The guys behind are not that far either so they can easily surprise us.
"I definitely don't feel we are in the fight for pole at all but we need to focus on getting a decent result."

items.titleZh: 拉尔夫·舒马赫致敬哥哥迈克尔及其在法拉利的永恒遗产
items.summaryZh: 在F1重返蒙扎参加意大利大奖赛之际，拉尔夫·舒马赫接受天空体育F1采访，回顾了哥哥迈克尔·舒马赫在F1的持久遗产及其在法拉利的影响力，以及他职业生涯中所承受并化为其动力的压力。

items.originalTitle: 拉尔夫·舒马赫致敬哥哥迈克尔及其在法拉利的永恒遗产
items.summaryEn: As Formula 1 returns to Monza for the Italian Grand Prix, Ralf Schumacher reflected in a Sky Sports F1 interview on his brother Michael Schumacher's enduring legacy, his influence at Ferrari, and the pressure he thrived under during his career.
detailZh: 拉尔夫·舒马赫向弟弟迈克尔致敬，并谈及他在法拉利F1留下的持久遗产
拉尔夫·舒马赫回顾了迈克尔·舒马赫在一级方程式中经久不衰的遗产、他在法拉利的影响力，以及他职业生涯中所承受并在此中茁壮成长的压力
埃迪·埃尔文（第二名）、迈克尔·舒马赫（第一名）和拉尔夫·舒马赫（第三名）
一级方程式重返蒙扎参加意大利大奖赛，距迈克尔·舒马赫首次为法拉利出赛已有30年，距这位七届冠军在2006年那场激动人心的胜利以及他首次宣布退役也已有二十年。
拉尔夫·舒马赫在接受天空体育 F1采访时，回顾了他兄弟在锦标赛中的传奇与影响，以及在蒙扎为马拉内罗车队效力所承受的压力。
"嗯，这非常令人动容，"舒马赫在观看了他兄弟在意大利大奖赛上夺冠的影像后说道，"你会渐渐遗忘一些事情，因为时间在流逝，F1发展得如此之快，一切都发生得太快了。"
"但再次看到那些照片，会让你想起他在那个年代所取得的成就。他是有史以来最伟大的车手之一。"
当被问到迈克尔来到蒙扎、大概已经知道自己即将宣布退役，却还在那样的压力下夺得冠军时，拉尔夫补充道："那很艰难。但他在压力下总是变得更加出色。而在法拉利，正如你今天所看到的，对所有车手、甚至对车队领队来说，都充满了压力，因为法拉利车迷和整个意大利的情感都在其中。"
"这个品牌太了不起了，不是吗？我在F1从来没有体验过其他任何像这样的东西。"
在分享他对哥哥的感人致敬时，舒马赫解释说，虽然他们之间只相差六岁半，但Michael是他成长过程中唯一的偶像。
"我总是被问到，'你的个人偶像是谁？'除了我哥哥，我从来没有过别人。这么说有点奇怪，因为我们只相差六岁半，但我所知道的一切关于赛车的东西，都是他教给我的。"这位前车手说。
"他是最早的车手之一，如果你想取得成就，这一点非常重要：付出100%的努力并相信自己，但不要忘记你身边的其他人。这就是他的强大之处——能够让整个团队围绕在他身边，为团队付出100%，团队也反过来为他付出100%，这让他如此成功。
“那是一个车手拥有更大影响力的时代。更多地是靠身体的感觉，由车手自己决定在哪里发展，那是他的强项，也是他个人的东西。因为我们刚刚采访了詹姆斯·沃尔斯，有人问到迈克尔（舒马赫）的优势是什么。他说：‘我可以告诉你，他认识车队里的每一个人。’
最后，舒马赫谈到了他弟弟1996年随法拉利取得的那场胜利，以及他作为旁观者看着这一切时的感受。
“对他们所有人来说那都是非常艰难的一年，因为期望值很高。我记得迈克尔和我坐在厨房里，他问我：‘你会怎么做？我有机会去迈凯伦，但那里有罗恩·丹尼斯，’他说，‘所以我对这个不太确定。然后我还有机会去法拉利，那是一个很大的很大的风险，但我很想去。’
“然后在1996年，他们一直想清除一些关键人物。连让·托特都承受着压力，每个人都一样。后来他们开始扭转局面，看到这一切简直太了不起了。
“我可以告诉你，这种情况并不常见，但当我和Michael一起登上领奖台时，到处都很美好，但在这里没有人关心我们。只有法拉利和Michael，法拉利才是最重要的。所以当你站在这里，看到所有那些人时，这是一种奇妙的感觉。”
意大利大奖赛——周六，图片报道
detailEn: Ralf Schumacher pays tribute to brother Michael and his lasting Ferrari F1 legacy
Ralf Schumacher has reflected on Michael Schumacher’s enduring Formula 1 legacy, his influence at Ferrari and the pressure he thrived under during his career
Eddie Irvine, 2nd position, Michael Schumacher, 1st position, and Ralf Schumacher, 3rd position

Formula 1's return to Monza for the Italian Grand Prix marks 30 years since Michael Schumacher's first race for Ferrari and two decades since the seven-time champion's emotional 2006 victory and his initial retirement announcement.
Speaking to Sky Sports F1, Ralf Schumacher reflected on his brother's legacy and influence in the championship and the pressures of driving for the Maranello outfit at Monza.

"Well, it is very emotional," Schumacher said after watching footage of his brother's success at the Italian Grand Prix. "You tend to forget things because time moves on, Formula 1 moves on so rapidly, everything happens so fast.
"But seeing all those pictures again reminds you of what he achieved in his time. And he was one of the biggest of all time."

When asked about Michael arriving at Monza, presumably knowing he would be announcing his retirement, and claiming the win under that pressure, Ralf added: "It was difficult. But he always became better with pressure. And at Ferrari, as you see also today, for all the drivers, even for the team principals, it's full of pressure because of the emotions of Ferrari fans and all of Italy.
"This brand is amazing, isn't it? I've never experienced anything else like that in Formula 1."
Sharing his own touching tribute to his brother, Schumacher explained that while there were only six and a half years between them, Michael was his only idol growing up.

"I was always asked, 'Who was your personal idol?' And I never had one except my brother. And it's strange to say that because we are only six and a half years apart, but all I ever knew about racing, he taught me," the former driver said.

"He was one of the first drivers, and that's what's so important if you want to achieve something: give 100% and believe in yourself, but don't forget the other people around you. And that was his strength - being able to have the team around him to give 100% for the team and vice versa, and that made him so successful.

"There was that time of drivers when the driver had much more influence. It was more the feeling of the body, the driver deciding where to develop, and that was his strength, and also the personal one. Because we're just having an interview with James Vowles and he was asked about the strength of Michael. He said, 'I can tell you, he knew every single individual in the team.'"
Finally, Schumacher touched on his brother's 1996 victory with Ferrari and what it was like for him watching from the outside.

"It was a very tough year for all of them because the expectations were high. And I remember when Michael and I were sitting in the kitchen, and he was asking me, 'What would you do? I have the chance to go to McLaren, but there's Ron Dennis,' he said. 'So I'm not sure about that. Then I have the chance to go to Ferrari, which is a big, big risk, but I would love to do it.'
"And then in 1996, they always wanted to get rid of some key people. Even Jean Todt was under pressure, everybody. And then they started to turn it around, and that was just amazing to see.

"And I can tell you, it was not so often, but when I was with Michael on the podium, it was nice everywhere, but here nobody cared. It was just Ferrari and Michael. Ferrari was the most important. So it's an amazing feeling when you are up here and see all those people."

items.titleZh: 意大利大奖赛周五练习赛赢家与输家盘点
items.summaryZh: 意大利大奖赛对梅赛德斯与法拉利两大车队及其车手而言是重要的周末，媒体从中挑选出周五练习赛的赢家与输家。

media.altZh: 意大利大奖赛周五练习赛赢家与输家盘点

items.originalTitle: 意大利大奖赛练习赛赢家与输家
items.summaryEn: The Italian Grand Prix is a big weekend for Mercedes and Ferrari, and The Race has picked out the winners and losers from Friday practice.
detailZh: 意大利大奖赛对于F1两支最大车队及其车手来说是一个重要的周末。
在梅赛德斯，安东内利是70多年来首位在主场大奖赛上领跑积分榜的意大利车手；而在车房的另一边，拉塞尔知道，考虑到安东内利将带着发车区（发车区）处罚参赛，这个周末为他提供了重燃争夺总冠军希望的绝佳机会。
我们怎么强调蒙扎这场比赛对法拉利的重要性都不为过——尤其是今年，车队仍怀有夺取F1总冠军的外围希望。
那么，这几方中谁开局强劲，谁又与他们并驾齐驱？又有谁已经需要这个周末出现戏剧性的好转呢？
以下是我们评选出的周五赢家与输家及其第二次自由练习赛的名次：
赢家：法拉利的新引擎（第2名和第5名）
法拉利的第二次ADUO升级是本周末前最大的话题，而早期的迹象令人鼓舞——勒克莱尔在第二次自由练习赛中排名第二，只比拉塞尔慢0.120秒，而且在长距离节奏上也名列前茅。
对此我们不仅必须加上通常的提醒，即这只是周五练习赛，还要注意勒克莱尔令人印象深刻的速度是使用软胎做出的，而梅赛德斯车手以及利亚姆·劳森那辆速度飞快的红牛赛车使用的是硬胎。
周五并不是下确定性结论的日子，但在一条会暴露法拉利动力劣势的赛道上，这至少是一个充满希望的开端。
考虑到两位车手都在使用的引擎升级本来就没指望能彻底消除劣势、而是缩小差距，这对于蒂福西（Tifosi，法拉利车迷）来说是令人鼓舞的。——埃德·斯特劳
输家：本田的最新引擎（第19名和第22名）
费尔南多·阿隆索周四表示，与这款升级引擎首秀的赞德福特赛道相比，蒙扎或许是检验本田的F1引擎究竟改进了多少的更好试金石。
而且，嗯……从这方面来看，初步结果并不理想。
蒙扎是一条马力至上的赛道。本田在这里很可能会暴露短板；赛道现场总经理兼总工程师折原晋太郎承认需要保持"现实"，并表示这对动力单元方面来说将是"具有挑战性的"。
但本田、阿斯顿·马丁和阿隆索（以及队友兰斯·斯特罗尔）肯定希望有比垫底更好的表现——他们的成绩夹在两台凯迪拉克之间，而且实际上比倒数第二慢的车每圈要慢超过一秒。（不计算埃斯特班·奥孔的哈斯赛车。）——杰克·科曾斯
"我不知道我们能否说自己是这个周末的热门，但比起过去两场比赛，我们可能拥有更大的机会——过去两场比赛的关键不太在于动力单元，而更多在于底盘。"
“现在差距非常小，排位赛里最后那零点一秒就可能决定几个名次，而这可能会改变领奖台的格局。现在，我还不知道哪支车队会是最强的那一支。”
这是拉塞尔在周四说的话，而在周五练习赛中登顶之后，他成了蒙扎赛道上“最需要被击败的车手”，他在第一节自由练习中还落后法拉利零点三秒，但在第二节自由练习中反超了勒克莱尔零点一二零秒。
这样一条缺乏能量的赛道理应天然发挥梅赛德斯赛车套件的固有优势，而且到了周六的第三节排位赛，拉塞尔还可以指望受到处罚的队友、同时也是冠军竞争对手安东内利的帮助。
因此，尽管我们还不知道升级后的ADUO 2法拉利引擎能带来多少额外性能，同时拉塞尔也必须面对自己那台梅赛德斯引擎已经相当疲劳的事实，但他至少已经以非常强势的姿态开启了这场比赛的周末。——本·安德森
还记得马克斯·维斯塔潘与红牛续约的消息公布时，车队和车手双方共同流露出的那份乐观情绪吗？
也许在这里直接把那件事拿来对比有失公允；维斯塔潘和红牛都知道他们本赛季不是冠军争夺者，即便那些亮眼的成绩也需要这位四届世界冠军使出一点魔力。
不过，自赞德沃特赛前那次公告以来，性能层面的局面看起来相当糟糕：在荷兰的冲刺赛中获得第六；在荷兰大奖赛中撞车；随后在蒙扎的第二次自由练习中又出现了种种抱怨——下压力完全不足（因此改了尾翼）、低速弯缺乏抓地力、刹车不给力，以及前轴出现“弹跳”。
这些问题现在看起来非常严重，以至于可能再次需要维斯塔潘上演英雄般的操作——只不过这次只是为了把红牛抬到中游集团之上。——JC
哈斯车队2026年最大的一次升级已经到位——但只完全装在了贝尔曼的车上。
他在第二节练习赛中带着新的车身套件和法拉利引擎（队友奥孔没有这两样装备）拿到了第八名，只比拉塞尔创造的最快圈速慢0.8秒，落后小红牛车队的阿尔维德·林德布拉德0.02秒。
“这绝对是我们大概自三月或那一时期以来最好的一个星期五，”贝尔曼说。
“我们需要一些提振，而今天对整个车队来说是一个巨大的提振，”他补充道。
贝尔曼对他对新升级套件的称赞加以保留——新套件让他在弯道中获得更多下压力，整体上也更有信心——原因在于周六的比赛将取决于尾流和赛道位置。
他补充说，这辆车的空气阻力比对手的稍大一些——但这是一个巨大的进步。
哈斯车队车辆工程主管霍吉·尼德表示：“这是一次巨大的升级。我们更新了所有的底盘。几乎座舱以后的所有车身部件都换新了。”
尼德呼应了贝尔曼的说法，即周五在蒙扎的表现是车队今年最强之一，哈斯希望能在周日的比赛中终结连续六站颗粒无收的局面。——萨马思·卡纳尔
奥孔虽然用上了新的车身套件，但并没有用上新的法拉利引擎，这是由于一级方程式技术规则中关于额外引擎认证步骤的一个特殊规定所致。他在第二节自由练习赛结束时比哈斯车队队友贝尔曼慢了一秒多。
哈斯车队的尼德确实试图淡化这种差距，他表示，奥孔或许没有得到"跻身前列的最佳机会"，因为新引擎并不能完全解释这种差距。
在第二节自由练习赛的飞驰圈中，交通拥堵也让奥孔吃了亏——这是蒙扎的经典桥段。
但很难回避这样一个事实：法拉利引擎（相对）缺乏爆发力，在这座速度圣殿将会非常痛苦，到了排位赛和正赛日，奥孔可能会发现自己位于车阵的尾部。——天空体育
detailEn: The Italian Grand Prix is a big weekend for two of Formula 1's biggest teams and their drivers.

At Mercedes, Kimi Antonelli is the first Italian driver to be leading the championship at their home grand prix for more than 70 years; while on the other side of the garage, George Russell knows this weekend offers a big chance to reignite his title challenge considering Antonelli is carrying a grid penalty.
And we can't really overstate how significant the Monza race is to Ferrari - not least this year, where it still has outside hopes of winning the F1 title.
So who from that quarter has started off strong, and who else is up with them? And who already needs the weekend to take a drastic upturn?
Here's our pick of Friday winners and losers and their FP2 positions:
Winner: Ferrari's new engine (2nd & 5th)

Ferrari's second ADUO upgrade has been the big talking point heading into the weekend, and the early signs are promising - with Charles Leclerc second fastest in FP2, 0.120s off Russell's pace and right up there on long-run pace.

To this we must add not only the usual caveat that this is Friday practice, but also the fact Leclerc's impressive pace was on the soft Pirellis versus the hards used by the Mercedes drivers - and the rapid Red Bull of Liam Lawson.
Friday isn't the day for definitive conclusions, but it's at least a promising start for Ferrari at a circuit that exposes its power deficit.
And given that the engine upgrade, which both drivers are running, was never expected to wipe out the disadvantage but reduce it, that's encouraging for the Tifosi. - Edd Straw
Loser: Honda's latest engine (19th & 22nd)
Fernando Alonso suggested on Thursday that Monza might be the better test of how much Honda's improved its F1 engine than the Zandvoort circuit at which it made its debut.
And, well... the initial results don't look great on that score.

Monza is the circuit where power is king. Honda was always likely to be exposed here; trackside general manager and chief engineer Shintaro Orihara accepted the need to be "realistic" and said it would be "challenging for [the] power unit side".

But Honda, Aston Martin, and Alonso (and team-mate Lance Stroll) would've wanted better than to be back at the foot of the table, sandwiching the Cadillacs, and realistically more than a second a lap off the next-slowest car. (Discounting Esteban Ocon's Haas.) - Jack Cozens

"I don't know if we can say we're favourites this weekend, but we probably have a greater opportunity than we've had in the last two races where it's been less about the power unit and more about the chassis.
"It's so close right now, that last tenth in qualifying can be the difference of a couple of positions, which can change the podium. Right now, I don't know who is going to be the team to beat."
This was Russell speaking on Thursday, before he became the 'driver to beat' at Monza by topping Friday practice, overturning a three-tenth deficit to Ferrari in FP1 to lead Leclerc by 0.120s in FP2.

Such an energy-starved circuit should naturally play to the inherent strengths of the Mercedes package, and Russell can also count on assistance from penalised team-mate and title rival Kimi Antonelli come Q3 on Saturday.

So, although we can't yet know how much extra performance is to come from that upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine, while Russell also has to deal with the fact his own Mercedes engine is growing quite tired, he's at least started this weekend very much on the front foot. - Ben Anderson
Remember when Max Verstappen's new Red Bull deal was announced and all the mutual optimism that was shared by team and driver?

Perhaps it's unfair to use that as a direct callback here; Verstappen and Red Bull know they're not title contenders this season and even the results that have stood out have required a touch of magic from the four-time world champion.

Still, the performance picture looks rough since that pre-Zandvoort announcement: sixth in the sprint in the Netherlands; a crash in the Dutch GP; and then the various complaints - of a total lack of downforce (and resulting wing change), lack of grip in slow-speed corners, the brakes not working, and the car "jumping" on the front axle - in FP2 at Monza.
Those seem so bad right now that some Verstappen heroics might be needed once again - only this time just to hoist Red Bull above the midfield. - JC
Haas's biggest upgrade of 2026 has landed - but only completely on Bearman's car.

And he took the new bodywork and Ferrari engine (which team-mate Ocon doesn't have) to eighth in second practice, just 0.8s off the ultimate pace set by Russell and 0.02s behind Racing Bulls's Arvid Lindblad.
"It's definitely been our best Friday since probably March or that time of year," said Bearman.
"We're in need of a bit of a boost and today has been a big boost for the entire team," he added.

Bearman caveated his praise of the new upgrade package - giving him more downforce through corners and more confidence throughout - with the fact that Saturday will be about slipstreams and track position.
He added that the car is a bit more draggy than rivals' - but it's a huge step up.
Haas head of car engineering Hoagy Nidd said: "It's a huge upgrade. We've updated all of the chassis. It's all of the bodywork rearwards of the cockpit pretty much."
Nidd echoed Bearman's comments on Friday at Monza being among the team's strongest of the year, as Haas looks to halt a six-strong run of point-less weekends on Sunday. - Samarth Kanal

Ocon has the new bodywork but not the new Ferrari engine, as part of a quirk of F1's technical regulations around additional engine homologation steps, and ended the day more than a second off Haas team-mate Bearman in FP2.
Haas's Nidd did play down the difference, saying that Ocon perhaps wasn't given "the best opportunity to get up there" as the new engine doesn't completely account for the disparity.
Traffic also cost Ocon on his FP2 push laps - a classic trope at Monza.

But it's hard to get past the fact that a (relative) lack of Ferrari engine pep will be painful at the temple of speed and Ocon might find himself towards the back of the pack come qualifying and race day. - SK

在本周末的意大利大奖赛上，一场火药味十足的新闻发布会上——巧的是 阿尔派 高级顾问 Briatore 和迈凯伦车队领队 Stella 都出席了——双方发生了引人瞩目的激烈冲突。
在该裁决公布后不久，阿尔派 发表声明对结果表示“失望”，但同时也表示车队“认可近期在巴黎举行的听证会上评审团的决定”。
布里亚托雷在仅仅几个小时后的新闻发布会上出人意料地改变了基调，他抱怨称听证会的四名评委中有一人与迈凯伦存在"工作关系"。
"首先，这非常不公平，但我们接受这个决定，"布里亚托雷说。"但非常奇怪的是评审团中的第三位评委，其中一名评委的行为就像检察官一样。"
红牛车队领队洛朗·梅基斯对哈贾尔在摩纳哥大奖赛中被恢复至第三名的消息作出反应

布里亚托利指出此人曾在2018年出席加州的一场慈善活动，他声称当时“三辆迈凯伦车中有两辆”被捐赠了出去。
“我们有一张这家伙在2018年迈凯伦活动演讲现场的照片，拍得很清楚，”布里亚托利说。
“当时有一位法官与一支抗议我们的车队有关联，这是相当不公平的。”
布里亚托利补充说，该法官在听证会上对阿尔派的代表“非常刻薄”，并表示他的团队正在“考虑”采取法律行动。
国际上诉法院“对程序的正当性和法官的公正性充满信心”
国际上诉法院于周六上午发表声明，表示它“已注意到公众对法官小组成员的独立性和公正性提出质疑的评论”。
声明继续说道：“FIA法院希望明确指出，与其他任何案件一样，该案中法官的任命和参与都是按照适用的FIA司法程序和惯例进行的，这些程序和惯例遵循最高标准，例如国际律师协会国际仲裁利益冲突准则。”
"所有评委均由国际汽联（FIA）代表大会选举产生，其中一些是根据国际汽联章程，由至少五支F1车队组成的团体提名而选举产生的。他们都须遵守《国际汽联司法与纪律规则》中规定的独立性和保密性要求，每年向国际汽联合规官披露利益情况，并针对每一个具体案件，结合所涉问题和有关各方，签署一份专门的独立性声明，该声明会送达各方当事人。
"在听证会的开始和结束时，双方当事人都被邀请就诉讼程序或法庭组成提出任何问题。双方均未提出。在听证会期间，也没有人对法庭询问证人或主持诉讼程序的方式提出任何异议。
"国际汽联上诉法院（ICA）强调由来自不同文化和地域背景的评委组成合议庭的重要性。这有助于确保审议和讨论反映多元的法律传统、观点和方法，进一步增强程序的公正性、独立性和可信度，以及获得公平审判的机会。
"法庭的裁决在法律依据方面可能留有多种解释和评论的空间；这是公平的，并为所有评委所接受。法庭对诉讼程序的稳妥性和评委的公正廉正充满信心。国际汽联法庭将继续致力于维护评委的独立性与公正性，以及司法程序的完整性。
据天空体育新闻了解，迈凯伦认为自己与涉事法官没有任何关联。
斯特拉：迈凯伦理应得到大量尊重
斯特拉起初选择不对布里亚托利的言论作出回应，但最终似乎以采取法律行动威胁这位意大利同胞。
“我发现这场发布会正朝着这个方向发展，这对迈凯伦、对一支理应得到大量尊重的车队的声誉来说是相当具有侮辱性的，”斯特拉说。
“而且，如果有人提出这种看起来相当严重的指控，他们将必须在公开场合为自己所说的话承担责任。”

“这场听证会，整个国际上诉法院的审理都是按照最高标准进行的。我们不应该质疑这一空间，就像之前已经做过的那样。”
detailEn: Andrea Stella says allegations from Alpine chief Flavio Briatore are 'insulting' for McLaren after court rules on Monaco podium

Red Bull’s Isack Hadjar restored to third in Monaco GP after Alpine driver Pierre Gasly’s time penalties were reapplied; McLaren and Red Bull won case at FIA's International Court of Appeal; watch Italian GP Qualifying live on Sky Sports F1 at 3pm on Saturday

McLaren's Team Principal Andrea Stella was not happy with Flavio Briatore's reaction to the ruling which meant Alpine's Pierre Gasly lost his Monaco GP third place finish after his two time penalties were reapplied

Andrea Stella has accused Alpine chief Flavio Briatore of "insulting" McLaren by questioning the relationship between the reigning constructors' champions and a judge at the FIA's International Court of Appeal.
The court announced on Friday that penalties given to Alpine driver Pierre Gasly during June's Monaco Grand Prix would be reinstated, following a successful appeal by McLaren and Red Bull.

Gasly took the chequered flag in third but was demoted when two five-second penalties for speeding in the pit lane were applied at that point. However, a right of review appeal from Alpine saw the penalties withdrawn five days later.

The reinstatement of the penalty drops Gasly back to seventh in the official classification. Red Bull's Isack Hadjar gets a podium in third, while McLaren's Oscar Piastri moves up to fourth.
Isack Hadjar was reinstated to the Monaco podium after a Red Bull appeal with Alpine expressing frustration as Gasly's penalty for speeding in pit lane was restored

In an explosive press conference at this weekend's Italian Grand Prix, which coincidentally featured Alpine executive advisor Briatore and McLaren team principal Stella, the pair engaged in a remarkable clash.

Alpine had put out a statement moments after the decision was announced expressing "disappointment" with the outcome but also said that the team "acknowledges the decision of the judging panel from the recent hearing in Paris".

Briatore stunned the room by striking a different tone in the press conference just a couple of hours later as he complained that one of the four judges at the hearing had a "working relationship" with McLaren.
"It's very unfair, firstly, but we accept the decision," Briatore said. "But what is very strange was the third judge in the panel, one of the judges acted like a prosecutor.
Red Bull Team Principal Laurent Mekies reacts to news that Hadjar had been restored to third in the Monaco GP
"For this, not a big problem. The problem is, he is very linked with the McLaren company."
Briatore pointed to the individual's presence at a charity event in California in 2018, at which he claimed "two of three McLaren cars" were donated.
"We have a nice picture of this guy at the speech for McLaren in 2018," Briatore said.
"It was quite unfair that one of the judges was linked with a team protesting us."
Briatore added that the judge in question was "very nasty" to Alpine's representatives during the hearing, and said that his team were "thinking about" taking legal action.
ICA 'confident in the soundness of the proceedings and the integrity of the judges'
The International Court of Appeal issued a statement on Saturday morning, saying it was "aware of public comments questioning the independence and impartiality of the judges of the panel".

The statement continued: "The FIA Courts wish to make clear that the appointment and participation of the judges in that case, like for any other case, were conducted in accordance with the applicable FIA judicial procedures and usual practice, which are inspired by the highest standards like the IBA Guidelines on Conflicts of Interest in International Arbitration.

"All judges are elected by the FIA General Assemblies, some of them upon proposition of a group of at least five F1 teams in accordance with the FIA Statutes. They are all subject to the independence and confidentiality requirements contained in the FIA Judicial and Disciplinary Rules, make annual disclosures of interests to the FIA Compliance Officer, and sign a specific declaration of independence for each particular case in consideration of the issue at stake and the parties involved, which is served to the parties.

"At both the beginning and conclusion of the hearing, the parties were invited to raise any issue concerning the proceedings or the composition of the Court. None did so. No objection was raised during the hearing concerning the manner in which the Court questioned the witness or conducted the proceedings.

"The ICA emphasises the importance of constituting panels with judges from different cultural and geographical backgrounds. This helps ensure that the deliberations and discussions reflect a diversity of legal traditions, perspectives and approaches, further strengthening the fairness, independence, credibility of the process and access to a fair trial.

"A Court's decision can leave room for various interpretations and comments as for its legal merits; that is fair and accepted by all the judges. The Court is confident in the soundness of the proceedings and the integrity of the judges. The FIA Courts remain committed to the independence and impartiality of their judges and to the integrity of the judicial process.
Sky Sports News also understands that McLaren consider they have no connection with the judge in question.
Stella: McLaren deserve a lot of respect
Stella initially chose not to respond to Briatore's comments, but eventually appeared to threaten his fellow Italian with legal action.
"I find that this conference is going in this direction quite insulting for McLaren, for the reputation of a team that deserves a lot of respect," Stella said.
"And if anybody makes this kind of allegations, which seem quite serious, they are going to have to take the responsibility for what they are saying in a public forum.

"The hearing, the whole international court of appeal was conducted to the highest standards. We should not question this space, like it's been done."

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔（拉塞尔）在周五的意大利大奖赛第二次练习赛中做出最快成绩，让蒙扎主场支持法拉利的车迷感到失望，而查尔斯·勒克莱尔（勒克莱尔）在一练中曾做出最快成绩，这次则退居第二。
两位梅赛德斯车手在早期几乎没有受到挑战地争夺最快圈速，拉塞尔似乎比他领跑积分榜的队友基米·安东内利（安东内利）略占上风——后者因更换引擎受罚，将在周日的正赛中从发车区末位起步。
在早些时候成功测试硬胎之后，拉塞尔连续两次用软胎做出全场最快，而安东内利在第一个正式飞驰圈结束时在帕拉波利卡弯追上一辆奥迪，也在一定程度上提升了他的成绩。拉塞尔自己也有一处隐忧：练习赛结束时出现了可疑的悬挂震动，他提醒车队对此进行检查。
勒克莱尔尽力复刻他在一练中做出的最快表现，并在距离练习结束仅剩13分多钟时用软胎一次成绩插到了两辆梅赛德斯之间，而那时梅赛德斯早已切换到长距离测试。在距离结束不到10分钟时，勒克莱尔在瓦尔泰拉·德拉·罗吉亚减速弯发生了严重打滑旋转，这是他这场总体干净的练习赛中的一个小瑕疵。
另一起重大事故波及了过去两站大奖赛的冠军兰多·诺里斯（诺里斯），他在接近本次练习赛开始时的一次事故中，为了避免兰斯·斯特罗尔（斯特罗尔）的阿斯顿·马丁，在一号弯冲上了草地，这一事故本可能严重得多。
与近期的状态一致，排名第四的诺里斯在速度上压过了迈凯伦队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里（皮亚斯特里）。两人在练习赛的最后10分钟里上演了一段耐人寻味的戏码，他们在相当长的一段时间内彼此贴得很近行驶，似乎是在模拟正赛的条件。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿（汉密尔顿）以第五名夹在两台迈凯伦之间，尽管在第一节自由练习中处于相近的时间窗口，他看起来还是比法拉利队友勒克莱尔（Leclerc）的节奏慢了一步，当然这可能源于不同的测试项目和载油量。
阿维德·林德布拉德（Arvid Lindblad）在练习赛前半段的大部分时间里都位居前三，最终代表小红牛以第七名令人印象深刻地领跑中游集团，排在奥利·比尔曼（Ollie Bearman）之前。
贝尔曼是本周末唯一一位使用升级版法拉利动力单元的哈斯车手，因为埃斯特班·奥孔——FP2排名第18——在最近几站比赛中优先获得了其他方面的升级，而可用的引擎只有一台。
结合一套空气动力学升级包，哈斯希望借此为其糟糕的状态找到解决办法，此前六站大奖赛他们一分未得。
马克斯·维斯塔潘在FP2中通过无线电表达的不满比平时更为强烈，这是他在蒙扎周末的首个练习时段，因为FP1中他的赛车由岩佐歩梦接管。
起初他抱怨完全没有下压力，这导致更换了前翼，随后又抱怨低速弯中没有抓地力，接着又说刹车失灵。在练习时段后期，维斯塔潘报告赛车前轴出现“跳动”，抱怨存在弹跳问题。
他排名第九，落后于贝尔曼，领先于红牛二队的第二辆车——角田裕毅，后者连续第二场代替利亚姆·劳森出战，劳森正在红牛顶替受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔。劳森名列第12，落后于驾驶阿尔派表现最佳赛车的弗朗哥·科拉平托。

detailEn: George Russell disappointed the Ferrari-supporting home crowd at Monza on Friday by setting the pace in second Italian Grand Prix practice, with Charles Leclerc demoted to second after setting the pace in FP1.

The two Mercedes drivers duked it out almost unchallenged early on for the top times, with Russell seemingly holding the edge over his championship-leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli - who will start at the back of the grid on Sunday for engine-change penalties.

After successful early running on the hard tyre, Russell topped the order on two consecutive soft-tyre runs, boosted by Antonelli catching an Audi at Parabolica at the end of his first proper flying lap. Russell also had a worry, ending the session with a suspicious suspension vibration he cautioned the team to look at.

Leclerc did his best to repeat his FP1-topping efforts, and did split the Mercedes with a soft run with just over 13 minutes to go in the session, well after Mercedes had switched to longer running. Leclerc's huge spin at the Variante della Roggia chicane with just under 10 minutes to go was a blemish on a mostly clean session for the grid.

The other major incident impacted the winner of the last two grands prix, Lando Norris, who ended up on the grass trying to avoid Lance Stroll's Aston Martin at Turn 1 in an incident near the start of the session that could have been much worse.

In line with recent form, Norris, in fourth, had the measure of McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri. The pair had an intriguing last 10 minutes of the session where they appeared to simulate race conditions by running very close to each other over a lengthy period.

Lewis Hamilton split the McLarens in fifth and appeared a step behind Ferrari team-mate Leclerc's pace despite being in a similar window in FP1, which could of course come from run plans and fuel loads.
Arvid Lindblad spent much of the first half of the session in the top three and ended up heading the midfield impressively in seventh for Racing Bulls, ahead of Ollie Bearman.

Bearman is the one Haas driver with the upgraded Ferrari power unit this weekend, as Esteban Ocon - 18th in FP2 - has been favoured for other upgrades in recent races and there was only one engine available.
Combined with an aero upgrade package, Haas will hope to have found an answer for its awful run of form, having failed to score at the previous six grands prix.
Max Verstappen was even more annoyed on the radio than usual in FP2, his first session of the Monza weekend as Ayumu Iwasa took over his car in FP1.

First he complained of a total lack of downforce, which led to a front wing change, then of no grip in slow-speed corners, and then his brakes weren't working. Later in the session Verstappen reported the car was "jumping" on the front axle, complaining of bouncing.

He finished behind Bearman in ninth, ahead of the second Racing Bulls of Yuki Tsunoda - making a second appearance in a row in place of Liam Lawson, who is substituting for the injured Isack Hadjar at Red Bull. Lawson was 12th, behind Franco Colapinto in the best of the Alpines.

Colapinto has the Alpine upgrade for the first time this weekend and beat his team-mate with it in FP2. He narrowly avoided a massive crash late in the session after finding the gravel at the exit of Ascari.

detailZh: F1意大利大奖赛：乔治·拉塞尔在二练中快过夏尔·勒克莱尔
梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔在F1意大利大奖赛第二次练习中领跑，法拉利与梅赛德斯在蒙扎互不相让
乔治·拉塞尔在F1意大利大奖赛第二次练习中占据榜首，以微弱优势将法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔挤下计时表首位。
拉塞尔在练习赛下半段跑出1分22.559秒的单圈成绩，这是这位英国车手、法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔以及拉塞尔的梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利之间一场练习中段较量的成果，三人包揽了前三名。
在硬胎上进行了几圈平淡无奇的练习之后，第二次自由练习赛在20分钟后开始升温，此前领跑车手们换上了倍耐力的软胎开始提速，而这种软胎在第一次练习赛中只是零星使用过。
在红色标记的软胎上，Antonelli做出了最快的第一计时段成绩，随后驶回维修站，因为他在蒙扎著名的一段最后一个弯角Parabolica被慢车阻挡。
在接下来的尝试中，Antonelli没有受到慢车干扰，做出了1分22.700秒的单圈成绩登顶榜首，随后队友Russell以1分22.686秒的单圈成绩接管了领跑位置。
在第一次练习赛中领跑的Leclerc随即以1分22.679秒的成绩做出回应，但Russell立刻以更有优势的1分22.559秒重新夺回了头名。
这个成绩一直保持到练习赛结束，因为各车队随后大多转入长距离模拟测试，勒克莱尔和安东内利因此分列第二和第三。
卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯赢得了过去两站大奖赛，本轮排名第四，仅落后拉塞尔0.4秒，而汉密尔顿驾驶第二辆法拉利排名第五，以微弱优势领先另一辆迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德为小红牛车队留下了深刻印象，在开局阶段一度占据第三位，最终做出第七快的成绩。奥利弗·比尔曼为陷入困境的哈斯车队取得了令人鼓舞的第八名。
第二节自由练习是马克斯·维斯塔潘本周末的首次出场，此前他将自己的红牛赛车交给了预备车手岩佐步梦，以完成强制的新秀出场安排。正如红牛车队周五的常态，维斯塔潘一直在为小红牛22寻找合适的平衡，更换前翼襟翼似乎也没有改善状况。
维斯塔潘作为红牛车队中成绩最好的车手，仅能排在第九位，小红牛的替补车手角田裕毅则位居前十的最后一名。由于利亚姆·劳森顶替受伤的伊萨克·哈贾尔为红牛出战，角田得以在他原先效力的车队再参加一个比赛周末。在二练中，劳森排在第12位，落后于阿尔派的佛朗哥·科拉平托。
值得注意的意外只有两起：一是勒克莱尔在第二个减速弯打滑，他的法拉利在很高的香肠路缘石上失去了车尾；二是涉及阿斯顿·马丁车手兰斯·斯特罗尔的一次危险阻挡事件。斯特罗尔驶出维修区通道时，这位加拿大车手大意地转向了诺里斯的行车路线上，诺里斯不得不采取避让动作。该事件将在本节练习结束后由国际汽联的比赛干事进行调查。
此外，奥迪车队也对博托莱托赛车尾部那台声音异常的V6发动机感到担忧，这迫使这位巴西车手提前放弃了原定的测试计划。
detailEn: F1 Italian GP: George Russell outpaces Charles Leclerc in FP2
Mercedes man George Russell leads second practice for F1's Italian Grand Prix as Ferrari and Mercedes trade blows in Monza
George Russell has topped second practice at Formula 1's Italian Grand Prix, nudging Ferrari's Charles Leclerc off the top of the timesheets.

Russell set a 1m22.559s lap in the second half of the session as part of a mid-session shootout between the Briton, Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Russell's Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who filled the top three.

Following tepid laps on hard tyres, also led by Russell, the second practice session came to life after 20 minutes when the frontrunners upped the pace by donning Pirelli's soft tyres, which had only been sporadically used in FP1.
On the red-rimmed tyres, Antonelli set a fastest first sector before diving back into the pits as he was blocked by traffic in the Parabolica, Monza's famed final corner.
On his next attempt, Antonelli was spared of traffic to fire in a 1m22.700s lap to go top, with team-mate Russell then taking over the lead with a 1m22.686s lap.
Leclerc, who had led the way in the first session, responded with a 1m22.679s effort, before Russell immediately claimed the lead back with a more comfortable 1m22.559s.
That time would remain untouched until the end as teams largely switched to long-run practice, with Leclerc and Antonelli thus finishing second and third.

Reigning world champion Lando Norris, winner of the last two grands prix, was fourth just four tenths behind Russell, while Hamilton was fifth in the second Ferrari, narrowly ahead of Oscar Piastri in the other McLaren.

Arvid Lindblad made a strong impression for Racing Bulls, briefly holding third in the opening stages before setting the seventh-fastest time. Oliver Bearman was an encouraging eighth for the struggling Haas team.

FP2 was Max Verstappen's first outing of the weekend after he handed his Red Bull to reserve driver Ayumu Iwasa for a mandatory rookie outing. As is often the case for Red Bull on Fridays, Verstappen was constantly chasing an agreeable balance on his RB22, with a front wing flap change not appearing to improve matters.

Verstappen could only muster ninth as the leading Red Bull driver, with Racing Bulls stand-in Yuki Tsunoda rounding out the top 10. Tsunoda gets a second weekend at his former team as Liam Lawson deputises for the injured Isack Hadjar at Red Bull. In FP2, Lawson placed 12th behind Alpine's Franco Colapinto.

The only incidents of note were a spin for Leclerc in the second chicane, losing the rear of his Ferrari on the high sausage kerbs, and a dangerous impeding case involving Aston Martin's Lance Stroll. As Stroll came out of the pitlane, the Canadian carelessly veered into the path of Norris, who had to take avoiding action. The incident will be investigated by the FIA race stewards after the session.
There was also some concern at Audi over an ill-sounding V6 engine in the back of Gabriel Bortoleto's car, forcing the Brazilian to abandon his run plan early.

detailEn: Italian GP: George Russell fastest in Practice Two as Mercedes edge ahead of fast-starting Ferrari at Monza

George Russell starts a big weekend in which Kimi Antonelli takes a grid penalty by setting Friday's fastest time at The Temple of Speed; Charles Leclerc leads Ferrari in second; watch final practice at 11.30am on Saturday ahead of Qualifying at 3pm, live on Sky Sports F1
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Italian Grand Prix.
George Russell beat Charles Leclerc to the fastest time of second practice at the Italian Grand Prix as Mercedes responded to Ferrari's early pace at Monza.

At an event in which championship-leading team-mate Kimi Antonelli will start at the back of Sunday's grid owing to engine-change penalties, Russell has a big chance to eat into the Italian's 59-point advantage if he can deliver a strong race weekend.

Ferrari had finished first and second quickest in opening practice as they debuted an upgraded engine but Russell was the driver to beat in the second session amid continued sweltering temperatures in northern Italy.

Lewis Hamilton, second fastest in the earlier running, slipped to fifth behind McLaren's Lando Norris during a session which included the Ferrari running straight on at the first chicane.

Norris has won the last two races but McLaren are expecting Monza's straights and slow chicanes to prove more challenging for their car. Fourth-fastest Norris was 0.384s off the second-practice pace with Oscar Piastri a further tenth behind in sixth.

The world champion was angered by what he perceived to be "dangerous" driving by Aston Martin's Lance Stroll midway through the session when he was forced off track at the first chicane. That incident was placed under a post-session stewards' investigation.

Max Verstappen returned after sitting out the first session for Red Bull rookie Ayumu Iwasa but the Dutchman was unhappy with his RB22's balance and was only able to set the ninth-fastest time. Stand-in team-mate Liam Lawson was 12th.

'This is his big chance' - Russell makes ideal start at Monza

While he certainly will not be getting carried away by setting the Friday pace, Russell has clearly got his weekend off to a positive start ahead of his bids for a first Grand Prix pole and win since the Austrian Grand Prix five events ago.
Sky Sports F1's Martin Brundle said: "He looked good. This is his big chance to close that deficit this weekend and show that he is very worthy of a world championship.
"What he desperately doesn't want to have to do is fall into line a few races down the road and protect Kimi Antonelli if there's an onslaught coming from McLaren or Ferrari at his championship lead.
"These are key races now for George Russell."
Mercedes Kimi Antonelli gives his thoughts on Ferrari after they debuted a new engine at the Italian GP practice sessions.

Antonelli, meanwhile, knows his weekend is already compromised given he will start from likely the back row of Sunday's 22-car grid. His programme on Friday was therefore more heavily weighted towards long-run pace.
"Today a bit of a different day compared to usual," said Antonelli.
"A lot more focused on long runs so it was a bit weird - not going to lie - but overall, it was a good day. We gathered a lot of data and now looking forward to the next few days."
Monza's long straights offer overtaking opportunities and Antonelli said he learnt lots from following other cars.
"It's a track where you can do so many different things," he added.

"It was interesting in the long run today running behind other cars to see what they were doing differently, where they were deploying compared to us. So it was very interesting. We have gathered a lot of data and now we look forward to tomorrow."

items.summaryZh: 阿尔派车队执行顾问弗拉维奥·布里亚托雷就国际上诉法院恢复对皮埃尔·加斯利摩纳哥大奖赛处罚的决定，与迈凯伦爆发激烈争执，并质疑其中一名法官的公正性。
items.originalTitle: 布里亚托雷就上诉法院法官与迈凯伦爆发激烈争执
items.summaryEn: Alpine executive advisor Flavio Briatore has become embroiled in a heated dispute with McLaren over the International Court of Appeal's decision to reinstate Pierre Gasly's Monaco Grand Prix penalties, questioning the impartiality of one of the judges on the panel.
detailZh: 阿尔派一级方程式车队的执行顾问弗拉维奥·布里亚托利就国际上诉法院恢复对皮埃尔·加斯利摩纳哥大奖赛处罚并剥夺其领奖台成绩的决定，与迈凯伦爆发了一场非同寻常的争执。
布里亚托利似乎质疑了国际上诉法院在审理迈凯伦和红牛对取消加斯利摩纳哥维修区超速处罚的决定提出上诉时，所任命的其中一名法官。
在阿尔派通过复审成功推翻加斯利的两项超速处罚后，加斯利被重新提升回摩纳哥大奖赛的领奖台位置，这两项处罚原本是在方格旗挥出时施加的，但红牛和迈凯伦随后提起的上诉导致加斯利在最终排名中又被降回第七位，而红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔则被重新提升回第三名。
在周五的意大利大奖赛车队领队新闻发布会上，布里亚托利挥舞着一张纸照着念，似乎质疑了8月听证会评审团中一名国际上诉法院法官——菲利波·马尔基诺——的公正性。
布里亚托利说：“首先，我们接受这个决定，但非常奇怪的是，在陪审团的四位裁判中，有一位裁判的行为就像一名检察官。”
“对我们来说，这不是一个大问题。问题在于他与迈凯伦这家公司关系非常密切，因为我们有一张这家伙的照片，那是2018年他在比佛利山庄的迈凯伦特别行动部门（MSO）为迈凯伦演讲时拍的。”
“他有一个基金会——叫做One Drop基金会——迈凯伦捐赠了两三辆迈凯伦汽车。”
“而我认为这相当不公平，其中一位裁判竟然与抗议我们的车队有关联。”
这些都是布里亚托雷提出的指控。马尔基诺未出席回应这些指控。
马尔基诺在国际汽联的简介中被称为一位“经验丰富的诉讼律师”，他“经常在美国办理一些最具技术性和挑战性的案件”。
在2023年12月的国际汽联大会上，他被列入当选国际汽联国际法庭和国际上诉法院法官的名单。
布里亚托雷辩称“法官通常应当是完全独立的”，并继续声称马尔基诺在听证过程中“非常刻薄”，而且“表现得像个检察官”。
布里亚托利继续说道："还有，后来我们发现了这个人为什么这么刻薄的原因是什么。他和迈凯伦关系非常密切。我很惊讶这个人居然和迈凯伦有关系。"
同样出席新闻发布会的迈凯伦车队领队斯特拉随后反驳道："我发现这场发布会正朝着对迈凯伦非常侮辱性的方向发展，对一个值得高度尊重的车队的名誉造成了伤害。
"如果有人提出这种看起来相当严重的指控，他们将必须为自己在公开场合所说的话承担责任。
"听证会，整个国际上诉法院，都是以最高标准进行的，我们不应该像现在这样质疑这个案子。"
有人问布里亚托利，为什么阿尔派没有质疑马尔基诺进入ICA审理小组一事。
“我们完全不知道这个人和迈凯伦有关系，”布里亚托利回答道。“我们去参加与迈凯伦的听证会时，我们才发现……这非常可笑，因为那位法官根本不是法官，他是一名检察官。”
“当时一共有四位法官，而这位实际上是针对FIA、针对我们、针对一级方程式管理公司的检察官。在那之后，也就是在与马尔基诺会面之后，我们才发现这个人和迈凯伦车队有关联。”
“所以这非常不公平，如果有些法官与正在和我们竞争的车队有关系的话。”
布里亚托雷反复强调，阿尔派 "接受这个决定，我们接受一切"，但他又回到了他所认为的利益冲突这一话题上，说道："这相当奇怪——评审团里居然有一个与车队有关联的人。"
对于车队是否正在考虑进一步的司法审查，他的表态含糊其辞，只说"我们在考虑下一步该怎么做"。
detailEn: The Alpine Formula 1 team's executive advisor Flavio Briatore has started an extraordinary row with McLaren over the International Court of Appeal's decision to reinstate Pierre Gasly's Monaco Grand Prix penalties and strip him of his podium finish.
Briatore appeared to question the appointment of one of the ICA judges presiding over McLaren and Red Bull's appeal against the decision to rescind Gasly's Monaco pitlane speeding penalties.

Gasly was promoted back into the Monaco GP podium places after Alpine succeeded in a right of review appeal against his two speeding penalties, which were applied at the chequered flag, but a further appeal launched by Red Bull and McLaren led to Gasly being demoted back to seventh in the final classification, and Red Bull's Isack Hadjar promoted back to third.

Reading from a piece of paper that he waved around during Friday's Italian GP team bosses' press conference, Briatore appeared to question the impartiality of one of the ICA judges - Filippo Marchino - on the panel during the August hearing.
"First, we accept the decision, but what is very strange is, of the four judges on the panel, one of the judges acts like a prosecutor," Briatore said.

"For us, that's not a big problem. The problem is that he's very linked with McLaren, the company, because we have a nice picture of this guy at the speech for McLaren in 2018 at McLaren Special Operations [MSO] in Beverly Hills.
"He has a foundation - it's called the One Drop Foundation - and McLaren gave two or three McLaren cars.
"And I think this was quite unfair, [that] one of the judges was linked with a team protesting us."
These are all accusations made by Briatore. Marchino was not present to respond to them.
Marchino's FIA biography calls him an "experienced trial Attorney" who "routinely litigates some of the most technical and challenging cases in the United States".
He was added to the list of judges elected to the FIA international tribunal and International Court of Appeal in the December 2023 FIA General Assembly.
Briatore argued "the judge normally would be independent, completely" and continued by claiming that Marchino was "very nasty during the hearing" and "acting as a prosecutor".
Briatore continued: "And after, we found out what is the reason why he's so nasty, this guy? He's very linked with McLaren. I'm very surprised this guy has the link with McLaren."

McLaren team principal Stella, also present in the press conference, later rebutted: "I find that this conference is going, in this direction, quite insulting for McLaren, for the reputation of a team that deserves a lot of respect.
"If anybody makes these kind of allegations, which seem quite serious, they are going to have to take the responsibility for what they are saying in a public forum.
"The hearing, the whole International Court of Appeal, was conducted to the highest standards, and we should not question this case like it's been done."
Briatore was asked why Alpine did not question the inclusion of Marchino on the ICA panel.
“We had no idea this guy was linked with McLaren," Briatore replied. "We go to the hearing with McLaren, and we see...it was very funny, because the judge was not a judge, he was a prosecutor.

"It was four judges, this one was really a prosecutor against the FIA, against us, against FOM [Formula One Management]. And after that, we found out, after the meeting with Marchino before, we found out this guy was linked with the McLaren team.
"So it's quite unfair, if some of the judge is linked with one of the teams that fighting with us."

Briatore repeatedly insisted that Alpine "accept the decision, we accept everything" but returned to his theme of a perceived conflict of interest, saying: "It's quite strange - to have one guy in the panel linked to the team.”
He was vague on whether his team is considering further judicial review, saying only "we're thinking about what we do next".

detailZh: 弗拉维奥·布里亚托利在蒙扎爆炸性的新闻发布会上质疑摩纳哥大奖赛上诉的公正性
在意大利大奖赛的一场非同寻常的新闻发布会上，阿尔派 F1高管弗拉维奥·布里亚托利质疑了恢复加斯利摩纳哥处罚的裁判之一的公正性
阿尔派 F1车队负责人弗拉维奥·布里亚托利质疑针对摩纳哥大奖赛结果的上诉程序的公平性，声称其中一名裁判与迈凯伦关系密切
加斯利是摩纳哥站因超出维修区限速而受罚的车手之一，该限速后来被发现是FOM测量错误所致。Gasly因此失去了第三名，但阿尔派对这些处罚提出了复议申请，FIA赛事干事同意撤销对这位法国车手的处罚
迈凯伦和红宝牛对这一决定提起了上诉，因为其他涉及到的车手已经服完了处罚，没有机会撤销这些处罚。
经过漫长的程序，国际汽联国际上诉法庭裁定支持上诉方，恢复了加斯利的两个五秒处罚，使他跌至第七名，而红牛车队的哈贾尔重新夺回了领奖台位置。
阿尔派车队在一份声明中对这一裁决表达了"失望和沮丧"。但在周五的国际汽联意大利大奖赛新闻发布会上，执行顾问弗拉维奥·布里亚托利走得更远，暗示听证会不公正，他声称四名法官之一的意裔美国人Filippo Marchino与迈凯伦有关联。
"我认为这非常不公平。我们接受这个决定，但非常奇怪的是，审判团里有四名法官，其中一名法官表现得像个检察官，"布里亚托利说。"本来是四名法官，而这个人对国际汽联、对我们、对FOM来说真的就像一个检察官。
"事后我们才发现这个人为什么如此恶劣。这与迈凯伦关系很大。我们有一张这个人2018年在比佛利山庄MSO为迈凯伦发表演讲的照片。他有一个基金会，叫做One Drop基金会，迈凯伦捐赠了两三辆迈凯伦赛车，这是相当不公平的。"
"我们接受这个决定，我们接受一切，但评审团里有一个与车队有关联的人，这非常奇怪。这是不公平的。法官通常需要完全独立。"
坐在布里亚托利身旁的迈凯伦车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉对这些指控明显感到吃惊。
"我发现这场发布会正朝着一个对迈凯伦来说相当侮辱的方向发展，侮辱了一支值得极大尊重的车队的声誉，"斯特拉反击道。"而且如果有人提出这类指控——这些指控看起来相当严重——他们将必须为他们在公开场合所说的话承担责任。
“听证会，整个国际上诉法院都是按照最高标准进行的，我们不应该像之前那样质疑这个案子。”
在谈到摩纳哥上诉的结果时——该结果还使迈凯伦车手皮亚斯特里从第五名升至第四名，并获得了两个额外的锦标赛积分——Stella表示：
“这个决定我们当然表示欢迎。这非常重要，因为它为FIA《国际运动规则》第1.1.1条的适用增添了明确性，而这一条是后续所有事项的基础。”
“我们提出上诉，是因为我们希望确保获得这种明确性。我们的担忧超出了我们可能失去两个锦标赛积分这一点。这两个锦标赛积分很可能不会产生任何影响。我们担心的是体育平等与公平的适用问题。这很重要，而且不仅仅是对迈凯伦而言。”
“事实上，不仅红牛提交了申请，所有车队都出席了听证会，因为这是一个非常重要的时刻，涉及我们如何适用规则、如何保持一致性，而且在这个具体案例中，一致性与在整个比赛周末有效的各种方法有关。”
布里亚托利于2024年6月重返F1，担任时任阿尔派首席执行官Luca de Meo的执行顾问。在他职业生涯早期，这位意大利人曾带领贝纳通车队和雷诺车队分别与Michael Schumacher和阿隆索一起赢得连续的世界冠军。
但此后，由于他在2008年新加坡“撞车门”丑闻中所起的关键作用，他被处以终身禁止进入围场的处罚。布里亚托利被指与一项阴谋有关，该阴谋涉及他的车手Nelson Piquet Jr故意撞车以引发安全车出动，从而帮助他的队友Alonso获胜。国际汽联的这一终身禁令于2010年被撤销，此后这位意大利人作为交易撮合者经常出现在围场，直到他正式回归阿尔派。
detailEn: Flavio Briatore questions Monaco GP appeal integrity in explosive Monza press conference
In an extraordinary press conference at the Italian Grand Prix, Alpine Formula 1 executive Flavio Briatore questioned the neutrality of one of the judges reinstating Pierre Gasly's Monaco penalties
Alpine Formula 1 boss Flavio Briatore has questioned the fairness of the appeal procedure against the Monaco Grand Prix results, claiming one judge has a close relationship with McLaren.

Pierre Gasly was one of several drivers penalised in Monaco for exceeding the pitlane speed limit, which was later found to be the result of an incorrect measurement by FOM. Gasly lost his third place, but Alpine launched a right of review against the penalties, with the FIA race stewards agreeing to rescind the Frenchman's penalty.
McLaren and Red Bull appealed against that decision, as the other drivers involved had already served their penalties and didn't have the opportunity to get those rescinded.

Following a lengthy procedure, the FIA's International Court of Appeal ruled in favour of the appellants and reinstated Gasly's two five-second penalties, dropping him to seventh as Red Bull's Isack Hadjar reclaimed a podium spot.

In a statement the Alpine expressed "its disappointment and frustration" with the ruling. But in the FIA's Italian Grand Prix press conference on Friday, executive advisor Flavio Briatore went much further, suggesting the hearing had been unfair as he claimed one of the four judges, Italian-American Filippo Marchino, had links to McLaren.

"I think it's very unfair. We accept the decision, but what is very strange was there were four judges on the panel and one of the judges acted like a prosecutor," Briatore said. "It was four judges, and this one was really a prosecutor against the FIA, against us, against FOM.

"Afterwards we found out what is the reason why this guy was so nasty. It's very linked with McLaren. We have a nice picture of this guy [giving a] speech for McLaren in 2018 at MSO Beverly Hills. He has a foundation, it's called One Drop Foundation and McLaren gave two or three McLaren cars, and this was quite unfair."
"We accept the decision, we accept everything, but it's quite strange to have one guy in the panel linked to the team. This is unfair. The judge normally needs to be independent completely."
Sitting alongside Briatore, McLaren team principal Andrea Stella was visibly taken aback by those accusations.

"I find that this conference is going in a direction that is quite insulting for McLaren, for the reputation of a team that deserves a lot of respect," Stella shot back. "And if anybody makes these kinds of allegations, which seem quite serious, they are going to have to take the responsibility for what they are saying in a public forum.
"The hearing, the whole International Court of Appeal was conducted to the highest standards, and we should not question this case like it's been done."
Commenting on the Monaco appeal outcome, which also moved up McLaren driver Oscar Piastri up from fifth to fourth and earned the two additional championship points, Stella said:

"It's a decision that definitely we welcome. It's very important, because it adds clarity in relation to the application of Article 1.1.1 of the International Sporting Code of the FIA, which is foundational for anything that derives from there.

"We appealed because we wanted to make sure that this clarity was sought. We had concerns which were beyond the fact that we might have lost two championship points. Probably these two championship points are not going to make any difference. We were concerned about the application of sporting equality and fairness. This is important and this is not only important for McLaren.

"In fact, not only Red Bull applied, but all teams were present in the hearing because this was a very important moment in terms of clarification as to how we apply the rules, as to how we apply consistency, and also in the specific case, consistency is related to the methodologies that are valid through our race weekend."

Briatore returned to F1 in June 2024 as an executive advisor to then-Alpine CEO Luca de Meo. Earlier in his career, the Italian helped steer the Benetton and Renault teams to consecutive world championships, with Michael Schumacher and Fernando Alonso respectively.

But he was subsequently handed a lifetime paddock ban for his instrumental role in the 2008 Singapore 'Crashgate' scandal. Briatore had been implicated in a plot that involved his driver Nelson Piquet Jr crashing deliberately to cause a safety car intervention that helped his team-mate Alonso win. That lifetime ban by the FIA was overturned in 2010, with the Italian a regular paddock presence as a dealmaker until his official return with Alpine.
